name: Decluttering & Fashion Rituals - Reading Circle
description:
You open a packed wardrobe and think, “I have nothing to wear.” Most of us treat fashion decluttering as a weekend chore: toss a few old clothes and accessories (material objects), clear a shelf, move on. But what we hold on to, and what we let go of, often says more about where we are in life than we’d admit.
Atta Galatta is hosting a reading and conversation around Bhawana Pingali’s The Art of Decluttering: Ancient Practices for Modern Living. There are no minimalist or maximalist rules and no styling tips. Instead, the evening is built around sthiram (or sthirata), the Sanskrit idea of steadiness, and the tweaked old Indian rituals Bhawana writes about in her book, which can make getting dressed feel like less of a chore.
Bhawana will read a few passages, take questions, and talk with the room about how clothes, body, mind, home, and identity shape our days. If you want to buy less and use more, are going through a change in your life, or simply like talking about fashion and books, you’re welcome to join.
About the Host
Bhawana Pingali is the author of The Art of Decluttering: Ancient Practices for Modern Living and the founder of Revastra, a storytelling platform that applies ancient Indian practices to how we care for our bodies, minds, and wardrobes. She is a fashion writer, researcher, and yoga-meditation facilitator whose work focuses on slow fashion and textile care. She also teaches writing on design and fashion communication as adjunct faculty at NIFT, Pearl Academy, Symbiosis, and IIM Ahmedabad. Her work encourages people to buy less on impulse and to see their clothes as a record of memory and identity.

name: The Pranic Advantage. Leaping Towards The Greatest Career Possibilities, Success & Impact - Pranic Healing Session
description:
Pranic Healing is a revolutionary no-touch, no-drug tested energy-based treatment that uses Prana, Chi or Energy to improve a wide range of physical, psychological, relationship, and financial issues.  Learn About The Power Of Pranic Self-healing for Professionals & Businesses. Learn how to simply and effectively eliminate constant stress, Anxiety, Fear, Confusion, Insecurities, Overload, and burnout.  Unlock Greater Clarity, Capability and Productivity. Achieve Personal & Professional (All-Round) Success & Fulfillment.
Questions & Answers: 1 Live Healing Demo
Speaker: Shravya Gubbi (Pranic Healer, 2X Entrepreneur)
Organiser: Pranic Healing for Free & Abundant Living

name: Lino Print Workshop - Art Workshop
description:
This hands-on workshop introduces the basics of lino cut printmaking, from carving a simple design to inking and printing your own artwork. Participants will be guided through the process step by step and will leave with their own prints, perfect as small artworks or gifts.
The session runs for three hours and includes demonstrations, supported making time, and space to experiment.
Open to beginners and anyone curious about printmaking — no prior experience needed. Suitable for ages 14+.
What should I bring?
Clothes you don’t mind getting messy in, ideas or finished sketches for designs (found images from books are welcome), and lots of creativity.
What’s provided?
All printing tools, paper, and inks will be provided.
What do I take home?
All finished artworks are yours to keep, along with any unfinished pieces. Participants will also keep their carved lino block, allowing them to reprint at home with basic supplies.
What's included:

Lino sheet
Lino carving tool
Lino ink
140gsm paper
Baren
Roller

name: Bella & Rami  - Book launch
description:
Join us at Atta Galatta for the book launch of “Bella & Rami”
 
About the Book: 
Bangalore, 1980. An Australian girl and an Indian boy fall in love at first sight. Decades of distance, loss, and hardship follow, yet their love endures. Bella & Rami is an unconventional romance based on a true story, told through scenes, letters, and poems.
 
About the Author:
Isobel de Border is an Australian author whose deep, lifelong connection to India shapes her narrative landscape. Her debut autofiction novel, Bella & Rami, draws extensively on real-world cross-continental correspondence, diaries, and archives spanning from 1980s Bangalore to contemporary Australia. Moving between both 
MEDIA KIT: ISOBEL DE BORDER AUTHOR
countries, her work explores the complex emotional geography of intimate relationships, and the interplay of time, distance and memory. De Border’s debut novel Bella & Rami is published in India by Timeless Script House, and internationally by Atmosphere Press, USA. De Border lives in Naarm, Melbourne, Australia
About the Host:
Asha Seth is an author, poet, former advertising Creative Director and the founder of MissBookThief, an award-winning literary platform that began as a book blog in 2012 and evolved into a book marketing agency working with authors and publishers.

name: Chouboli - Storytelling performance
description:
What if a centuries-old folktale could speak to the modern world? 
Chouboli is a storytelling performance in Hindi, adapted from the renowned author Vijaydan Detha's biting satire in Rajasthani.  
Funny, philosophical and a little wild, It weaves ethical dilemmas and lyrical riddles into a story-within-a-story that is part fantasy, part mirror.
A beautiful mess of being human, presented with sharp wit and seamless flow between fantasy and realism, magic and logic, fact and fiction!  
90 minutes. Entirely alive!
Language : Hindi  
Adaptation & performance by Narendra Shekhawat

name: Mahabharata Tales for Adults - Storytelling
description:
As everyone’s eyes turn to the Ramayana, we’re stepping back to revisit the stories of the Mahabharata.
Join Indic storyteller Aparna Jaishankar as she unpacks the intrigue, secret affairs, drama, and unforgettable stories that have captivated us for generations. Whether you’re returning to familiar legends or hearing them with fresh eyes- this epic is not something you want to miss.
From folktales, to lesser known regional stories- see the Mahabharata through a fresh set of eyes

name: Divine Delicacies - Storytelling and Menu Tasting Session
description:
Where food meets faith, and every prasadam has a story!
Can you imagine worship without food? From festival feasts to little-known prasadams and fascinating rituals, food has always been an essential part of our connection with the divine.
Join Aparna Jaishankar for a deliciously different storytelling experience! Come taste samples of home-made temple offerings while discovering the stories behind them. A bit of history, mythology, philosophy, politics all served for the divine palate! Come hungry. Come curious. Leave with a whole new appetite for stories!

name: A Little Book of Light - Book lamp-making workshop
description:
A few blank pages, a little folding, a little imagination… and a touch of light!  
What if a book could glow?  
Come spend a cosy afternoon folding, shaping, and bringing pages together to create your very own little book lamp.  
Where origami meets bookmaking, ordinary paper takes on a whole new form — a sculptural creation that glows with a warm, gentle light.  
No experience needed. Just bring your curiosity and a little love for making things by hand.  
We'll bring all the materials. You bring yourself!  
Fold · Create · Illuminate

name: The Fearless Four - Book launch
description:
Join us at Atta Galatta for the book launch of “The Fearless Four”
Who says mystery is only for grown-ups? Meet Meenu, Damayanthi, Avisu, and Zara – four brave best friends who call themselves ‘The Fearless Four’. The Fearless Four part 2 - The paper's, the phrase and the chase is a sequel to the Fearless Four part 1. It is about question papers for a national level exam which mysteriously disappear and the Fearless Four have to solve the mystery.
About the Author: Avya Krishna is a student of Grade 6 at Baldwin Girls High School, Bangalore. She is learning the piano, Bharatanatyam, and is also a medal 
winner in swimming. She is an avid reader. Right from the tender age of three, she was always found with a book in hand. Trekking and adventures excite her, and she is been on a couple of camps and treks with her family. Inspired by her parents who have also authored books, she took a keen interest in writing. 
She was also awarded by the District Governor of Rotary Club, Chennai for her exemplary performance.  
As a part of this launch, she would be planning an engaging session with kids aged 4 plus and their parents

name: Let Poetry Be - Poetry Open Mic
description:
This monthly gathering will see poetry coming to life through reading, music, art, and any other forms of artistic expression at Atta Galatta. Listeners and performers are all welcome!
Date: 28th November
Time: 4 pm- 6 pm 
Venue: Atta Galatta, Indiranagar
 
Event specifics & submission guidelines –
 
1. Theme - “If I could…”
2. Works can be original or of other poets, performed live
3. All languages welcome
4. Participants can read to music (acoustic instrument/s), dramatise, use props & costumes
5. Each participant will enjoy 5 minutes of reading time
6. Kindly submit your poem and name to letpoetrybe@gmail.com on or before 26th November midnight. WE WILL NOT ACCEPT ATTACHMENTS OR LINKS. SUBJECT OF YOUR MAIL MUST READ AS 'Entry for-NovemberLPB meet-up'
7. You may also send entries that are not related to the theme
8. The event will begin at 4 pm sharp and will be held at Atta Galatta. Participants are to report no later than 3:45 pm to hear about the performance order and meet the host
9. For any further clarifications, write to us at letpoetrybe@gmail.com
You are now welcome to flood our inbox!

name: Conversations and practices for pleasure, presence, and connection - Panel Discussion and Workshop
description:
PANEL DISCUSSION | Beyond the Hands
Conversations about sex work often centre a female-centred story. Male and trans sex workers speak about visibility, representation, and being left out of the dominant narrative.
WORKSHOP | Sensual Play: Sensuality Is a Practice
Why can touch feel electric with one person and disconnected with another? This consent-forward workshop explores sensuality as attention, not just technique. Through somatic exercises, solo and partnered practice, and a look at how the nervous system processes touch, safety, and arousal, you'll release performance anxiety and return to genuine feeling.

name: Read A Kitaab- Meet up - Book Club
description:
This November, we’re bringing together stories, voices, cultures and perspectives from across the world at our Bengaluru Monthly Meetup.
From books that cross borders to stories that transcend languages, identities and communities, let’s celebrate the beautiful diversity of the reading world.

Whether you love discovering translated literature, exploring unfamiliar cultures or simply finding your next favourite read, there’s a place for you at this gathering!

📚 Theme: Books Beyond Borders – Books from the World
📅 Sunday, 29 November 2026
⏰ 5 PM – 7 PM
📍 Atta Galatta, Indiranagar, Bengaluru
✨ Entry is FREE, but registration is mandatory.

Come with a book recommendation, an open mind and a curiosity for stories beyond your own borders.
Because the world is far too big to be read in just one language. ❤️
Register now!

name: Rhyme and Rasam-  Poetry That's Easy to Love - A Discussion Group
description:
Rhyme & Rasam: Poetry That's Easy to Love
How have poets considered winter? Is the mood always grim and soulful? And what of poets in warmer climates like ours?
In this edition of Rhyme & Rasam, we will read a range of poets who step away from clichés, and bring us new visions of winter.
Come for an evening of guided readings, and share what the poems make you think, feel and notice.
Rhyme & Rasam is designed to deepen your love of words. You don't even have to love poetry to join. We keep it accessible to everyone. Depth of flavour assured!
Theme: Winter Poems
Hosted by writer and poet Suchi Govindarajan
What's included:
Tea and Coffee (and maybe rasam for the weather!)

name: ಒಂದು ವಲಸೆ ಕಥೆ - Book launch
description: On 6 December 2026, from 11 am to 1 pm, join Indian-American traveler, poet, and novelist Kiran Bhat as he launches his first Kannada-language poetry book, ಒಂದು ವಲಸೆ ಕಥೆ. Bhat will discuss how he writes poetry in different languages and his experiences living in various countries. The event will be guided by fellow poet Dadapeer Jyman.

name: Room on the Roof - Book launch
description: Illustrator Saumya Oberoi is thrilled to welcome you to the book launch of The Room on the Roof: A Graphic Novel, a special adaptation of Ruskin Bond's classic first novel. This book tells the coming-of-age story of Rusty afresh as he runs away from his strict English guardian’s house to rent a room on the roof in post-Independence Dehradun. Along the way, he discovers a world of true friendship, innocent first love, and a profound understanding of the self. Learn about the process behind the 125-page full-color book and enjoy an evening of chatting about graphic narratives, storytelling for young adults, and the importance of chaat!

name: Submergence - Book Signing
description:
Join us at Atta Galatta for a special book signing with Anjali M S, a young, up-and-coming author who is about to release her YA dystopian book Submergence. Submergence is a dystopian novel set in a future where wars, pollution, and a catastrophic asteroid impact have submerged nearly all of Earth, leaving behind one continent divided between two rival governments. While one fights to restore the dying planet, the other looks to space travel for humanity’s salvation. Caught between these opposing ideologies are a spy and a murderous soldier whose fates are dangerously intertwined.
Come meet Anjali, discover her work, and get your copy signed. Whether you're an enthusiastic reader, an aspiring writer, or simply someone who loves a good story, this is an opportunity to connect with a young author and celebrate the joy of books.


Date: 23 January 2027


Time: 2:00–3:00 PM


Venue: Atta Galatta, Bengaluru


Instagram handle: @anjalims_author


Format: Author meet-and-greet and book signing


Age Group: 12+ 


We look forward to welcoming readers for an afternoon celebrating books, storytelling, and the next generation of authors.
